links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT responses about PRP therapy versus recommended 8th grade level
links.effect: Mean reading grade levels of 17.18 (ChatGPT 3.5) and 16.36 (ChatGPT 4), significantly above the recommended 8th grade level for patient education materials.
links.quote: However, both versions produced content significantly above the recommended 8th grade reading level for patient education materials (PEMs), with mean reading grade levels (RGLs) of 17.18 for ChatGPT version 3.5 and 16.36 for ChatGPT version 4, indicating a potential barrier to their utility in patient education.
